blob.description: The content key of the bytes these rows describe

variant.description: How the bytes were parsed: `json` strict (no comments, no trailing commas), `jsonc` with comments and trailing commas, `yaml` as a YAML 1.2 stream under the core schema (every document, aliases expanded, `<<` a plain key)

documents.description: Documents in the file; JSON has one, a YAML stream any number, 0 when it holds none

bom.description: Whether the bytes began with a byte order mark

maxDepth.description: The largest depth of a container node; 0 when the root is a scalar
